column1: # capture-private-siblings.tsv: route capture/* custody refs to a PRIVATE sibling repo.
# Some repos keep sensitive material (chat exports, personal or legal text) out of the
# original and in a private "<repo>--private" sibling. capture.sh snapshots whole working
# trees, so for those repos its capture/* side refs must land in the sibling, not the original.
# Format: <origin owner/repo><TAB or spaces><sibling push URL>
# Matching is case-insensitive on the origin's owner/repo (https or ssh origins both work).
# Repos not listed here keep the default behavior (capture/* pushed to origin).
